description.en: When the village argues about the car park by the tarn, Old Wilf chairs the debate at the Packhorse Inn: claims and evidence, the arguments for and against, the pros and cons, and the compromise at the end.
description.sl: Ko se vas prepira o parkirišču ob jezercu, stari Wilf vodi razpravo v gostilni Packhorse: trditve in dokazi, argumenti za in proti, prednosti in slabosti ter na koncu kompromis.
description.it: Quando il paese discute del parcheggio vicino al laghetto, il vecchio Wilf modera il dibattito al Packhorse Inn: affermazioni e prove, gli argomenti a favore e contro, i pro e i contro e alla fine il compromesso.
description.de: Wenn das Dorf über den Parkplatz am Bergsee streitet, leitet der alte Wilf die Debatte im Packhorse Inn: Behauptungen und Beweise, die Argumente dafür und dagegen, Vor- und Nachteile und am Ende der Kompromiss.

words.example_en: The council's claim that the car park would bring jobs was never proved.
words.example_sl: Trditev občine, da bo parkirišče prineslo delovna mesta, ni bila nikoli dokazana.
words.example_it: L'affermazione del consiglio che il parcheggio avrebbe portato lavoro non è mai stata provata.
words.example_de: Die Behauptung des Gemeinderats, der Parkplatz bringe Arbeitsplätze, wurde nie bewiesen.
words.note: Claim is also a verb: He claims he saw a wolf. And a claim on an insurance is a request for money.
words.note_sl: Claim je tudi glagol: He claims he saw a wolf. Pri zavarovanju je claim zahtevek.
words.note_it: Claim è anche un verbo: He claims he saw a wolf. Per un'assicurazione è una richiesta di risarcimento.
words.note_de: Claim ist auch ein Verb: He claims he saw a wolf. Bei einer Versicherung ist es ein Anspruch.

words.example_en: There is no evidence that the path is dangerous.
words.example_sl: Ni dokazov, da je pot nevarna.
words.example_it: Non ci sono prove che il sentiero sia pericoloso.
words.example_de: Es gibt keine Beweise, dass der Weg gefährlich ist.
words.note: Evidence is uncountable: a piece of evidence, never an evidence.
words.note_sl: Evidence je neštevno: a piece of evidence, nikoli an evidence.
words.note_it: Evidence non si conta: a piece of evidence, mai an evidence.
words.note_de: Evidence ist unzählbar: a piece of evidence, nie an evidence.

words.example_en: In the end she persuaded her neighbours to sign the letter.
words.example_sl: Na koncu je sosede pregovorila, da so podpisali pismo.
words.example_it: Alla fine ha persuaso i vicini a firmare la lettera.
words.example_de: Am Ende hat sie die Nachbarn überredet, den Brief zu unterschreiben.
words.note: Persuade someone to do something; convince someone that something is true.
words.note_sl: Persuade someone to do (pregovoriti k dejanju); convince someone that (prepričati o resnici).
words.note_it: Persuade someone to do (indurre a fare); convince someone that (convincere che è vero).
words.note_de: Persuade someone to do (zu etwas überreden); convince someone that (von etwas überzeugen).

words.example_en: Most of the farmers support the plan for a new bridge.
words.example_sl: Večina kmetov podpira načrt za nov most.
words.example_it: La maggior parte degli agricoltori sostiene il progetto del nuovo ponte.
words.example_de: Die meisten Bauern unterstützen den Plan für eine neue Brücke.

words.example_en: The National Trust opposed the plan from the start.
words.example_sl: National Trust je načrtu nasprotoval od začetka.
words.example_it: Il National Trust si è opposto al progetto fin dall'inizio.
words.example_de: Der National Trust hat sich dem Plan von Anfang an widersetzt.

words.example_en: Are you in favour of closing the road on Sundays?
words.example_sl: Si naklonjen zapori ceste ob nedeljah?
words.example_it: Sei a favore della chiusura della strada la domenica?
words.example_de: Bist du dafür, die Straße sonntags zu sperren?

words.example_en: Twenty people voted for and thirty against.
words.example_sl: Dvajset ljudi je glasovalo za, trideset proti.
words.example_it: Venti persone hanno votato a favore e trenta contro.
words.example_de: Zwanzig Leute haben dafür gestimmt und dreißig dagegen.

words.example_en: From a farmer's point of view, more walkers mean more open gates.
words.example_sl: S kmetovega stališča več pohodnikov pomeni več odprtih vrat.
words.example_it: Dal punto di vista di un contadino, più escursionisti vogliono dire più cancelli aperti.
words.example_de: Aus der Sicht eines Bauern heißen mehr Wanderer mehr offene Gatter.

words.example_en: As far as I'm concerned, the tarn should stay as it is.
words.example_sl: Kar se mene tiče, naj jezerce ostane, kakršno je.
words.example_it: Per quanto mi riguarda, il laghetto deve restare com'è.
words.example_de: Was mich betrifft, soll der Bergsee bleiben, wie er ist.

words.example_en: It's worth getting up early to see the sunrise from Catbells.
words.example_sl: Splača se zgodaj vstati, da vidiš sončni vzhod s Catbellsa.
words.example_it: Vale la pena alzarsi presto per vedere l'alba dal Catbells.
words.example_de: Es lohnt sich, früh aufzustehen, um den Sonnenaufgang vom Catbells zu sehen.

words.example_en: I'd rather walk than wait an hour for the bus.
words.example_sl: Raje bi šel peš, kot da čakam uro na avtobus.
words.example_it: Preferirei andare a piedi che aspettare un'ora l'autobus.
words.example_de: Ich würde lieber laufen, als eine Stunde auf den Bus zu warten.
words.note: I'd rather + the verb without to: I'd rather stay. I'd rather you stayed: the past for someone else.
words.note_sl: I'd rather + glagol brez to: I'd rather stay. Za drugega preteklik: I'd rather you stayed.
words.note_it: I'd rather + verbo senza to: I'd rather stay. Per un altro il passato: I'd rather you stayed.
words.note_de: I'd rather + Verb ohne to: I'd rather stay. Für jemand anderen Vergangenheit: I'd rather you stayed.

words.example_en: After two hours they reached a compromise: a smaller car park, further from the water.
words.example_sl: Po dveh urah so dosegli kompromis: manjše parkirišče, dlje od vode.
words.example_it: Dopo due ore hanno trovato un compromesso: un parcheggio più piccolo, più lontano dall'acqua.
words.example_de: Nach zwei Stunden fanden sie einen Kompromiss: einen kleineren Parkplatz, weiter weg vom Wasser.

words.example_en: The new wind turbine on the ridge is very controversial.
words.example_sl: Nova vetrnica na grebenu je zelo sporna.
words.example_it: La nuova pala eolica sul crinale è molto controversa.
words.example_de: Das neue Windrad auf dem Grat ist sehr umstritten.

words.example_en: The debate went on until the landlady rang the bell for last orders.
words.example_sl: Razprava je trajala, dokler gostilničarka ni pozvonila za zadnja naročila.
words.example_it: Il dibattito è andato avanti finché l'ostessa non ha suonato la campana per le ultime ordinazioni.
words.example_de: Die Debatte ging weiter, bis die Wirtin zur letzten Runde läutete.

words.example_en: Housing for young people is the biggest issue in the dale.
words.example_sl: Stanovanja za mlade so največje pereče vprašanje v dolini.
words.example_it: La casa per i giovani è la questione più grande della valle.
words.example_de: Wohnraum für junge Leute ist die größte Streitfrage im Tal.
words.note: An issue is a problem people discuss; in letters it can also be a magazine's number.
words.note_sl: Issue je problem, o katerem se razpravlja; pri reviji tudi številka.
words.note_it: Issue è un problema di cui si discute; per una rivista anche il numero.
words.note_de: Issue ist ein diskutiertes Problem; bei einer Zeitschrift auch die Ausgabe.

words.example_en: The council will consider every letter before it decides.
words.example_sl: Občina bo pred odločitvijo pretehtala vsako pismo.
words.example_it: Il consiglio considererà ogni lettera prima di decidere.
words.example_de: Der Gemeinderat wird jeden Brief erwägen, bevor er entscheidet.
words.note: Consider + -ing: We're considering moving to Keswick.
words.note_sl: Consider + -ing: We're considering moving to Keswick.
words.note_it: Consider + -ing: We're considering moving to Keswick.
words.note_de: Consider + -ing: We're considering moving to Keswick.

words.example_en: Don't assume that everyone here owns a car.
words.example_sl: Ne predpostavljaj, da ima tu vsak avto.
words.example_it: Non presumere che qui tutti abbiano la macchina.
words.example_de: Geh nicht davon aus, dass hier jeder ein Auto hat.

words.example_en: Several residents objected to the noise from the new campsite.
words.example_sl: Več prebivalcev je ugovarjalo hrupu z novega kampa.
words.example_it: Diversi residenti hanno obiettato al rumore del nuovo campeggio.
words.example_de: Mehrere Anwohner haben Einwände gegen den Lärm vom neuen Campingplatz erhoben.
words.note: The verb is ob-JECT; the noun object (a thing) is OB-ject. Object to something.
words.note_sl: Glagol ob-JECT; samostalnik object (predmet) OB-ject. Object to something.
words.note_it: Il verbo è ob-JECT; il nome object (oggetto) OB-ject. Object to something.
words.note_de: Das Verb ob-JECT; das Nomen object (Gegenstand) OB-ject. Object to something.

words.example_en: Her argument was simple: without the bus, the old people can't get to the doctor.
words.example_sl: Njen argument je bil preprost: brez avtobusa starejši ne morejo do zdravnika.
words.example_it: La sua argomentazione era semplice: senza l'autobus gli anziani non possono andare dal medico.
words.example_de: Ihr Argument war einfach: Ohne den Bus kommen die Alten nicht zum Arzt.
words.note: An argument is also a quarrel: They had an argument about money.
words.note_sl: Argument je tudi prepir: They had an argument about money.
words.note_it: Argument è anche un litigio: They had an argument about money.
words.note_de: Argument ist auch ein Streit: They had an argument about money.

words.example_en: He admitted that he had left the gate open.
words.example_sl: Priznal je, da je pustil vrata odprta.
words.example_it: Ha ammesso di aver lasciato il cancello aperto.
words.example_de: Er hat zugegeben, dass er das Gatter offen gelassen hatte.

words.example_en: The boys denied that they had thrown stones at the sheep.
words.example_sl: Fantje so zanikali, da so metali kamenje v ovce.
words.example_it: I ragazzi hanno negato di aver tirato sassi alle pecore.
words.example_de: Die Jungen leugneten, Steine auf die Schafe geworfen zu haben.

words.example_en: Let's write down the pros and cons before we decide.
words.example_sl: Zapišimo prednosti in slabosti, preden se odločimo.
words.example_it: Scriviamo i pro e i contro prima di decidere.
words.example_de: Lass uns die Vor- und Nachteile aufschreiben, bevor wir entscheiden.

words.example_en: Bear in mind that the last bus leaves at six.
words.example_sl: Imej v mislih, da zadnji avtobus odpelje ob šestih.
words.example_it: Tieni presente che l'ultimo autobus parte alle sei.
words.example_de: Bedenke, dass der letzte Bus um sechs fährt.

words.example_en: Your idea makes sense, but who's going to pay for it?
words.example_sl: Tvoja zamisel je smiselna, a kdo jo bo plačal?
words.example_it: La tua idea ha senso, ma chi la pagherà?
words.example_de: Deine Idee ergibt Sinn, aber wer soll das bezahlen?
